conclusions: Reuse unique owner status and existing strict UTC core. DPERF05 only proves update parsing, not task elapsed time.
Optional missing/invalid timing facts belong to timing issues, not global status errors; no historical migration.
Elapsed is wall time including waits at snapshot.generatedAt, not measured active effort. Explicit incomplete differs from unknown completion. No mtime/claim/Git or branch delivery inference.
Review, main integration and deployment remain separately verified; historical milestone times cannot promote current target state.
Two product literals plus targeted tests is a reasonable proposed scope, pending final Lead field contract and actual writer handoff.
adjustments: The report final future admission sentence is superseded by the latest Lead OPS direction: ordinary reversible implementation and local checks use one bounded continuous work segment, preserve failure originals and finish with one review/integration; no per-check preparation/permission chain. PG/Chrome/personal-service changes still retain necessary isolation.
NOT_COMPLETED is a proposed explicit fact representation, not a final new project-wide enum. Reuse Lead-selected equivalent if available.
If stale data retains a historical computed duration, label its observation instant and avoid a current/in-progress claim.

officialSources.basis: Nonstandard parsing and date-time without timezone are unsuitable for authoritative instants.
Date wall clock can adjust; monotonic time is not a source for historical task instants.
Background timers are throttled; no per-card timer is needed for snapshot-time duration.

cleanCode: Reviewed source isolation, input semantics, error locality and avoidance of unnecessary new timers/stores. No project implementation writes or application/test execution.
